title: Her husband booked a sunrise paddle
why: POV trip story from one real review (Alexandra S., Jul 2026) to sell morning/wildlife paddles and experience gifts.
hook_options: The birthday gift that started at sunrise
Birds, turtles, and no heat yet
Why one guest picked sunrise on the bayou
caption: Alexandra S. spent her birthday morning on Buffalo Bayou. 'Going on the sunrise tour rocked because there were lots of birds out and it wasn't hot yet.' A better gift than another candle. #buffalobayou #houstonkayak #buffalobayoukayak #experiencegift

slides.headline: Her husband booked a sunrise paddle
slides.body: Alexandra S. spent her birthday morning on Buffalo Bayou. Here's how it went, in her words.

slides.headline: A sunrise wildlife tour, as a gift
slides.body: "My husband booked us a sunrise wildlife kayak tour... for my birthday and it was so much fun!"

slides.headline: "It wasn't hot yet"
slides.body: Her reason, and it's a good one. Early on the bayou, the heat hasn't shown up and the birds have.

slides.headline: "There were lots of birds out"
slides.body: Herons, egrets and smaller birds work the banks early. Common, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Birds, fish, and turtles
slides.body: Her list, in that order. Guides watch the banks so guests know where to look.

slides.headline: Houston history from water level
slides.body: She "learned a lot about the history of Houston and the buildings nearby." The bayou is where the city started.

slides.headline: "Our paddle was serene"
slides.body: Her word. Flat water, an easy pace, downtown showing up between the trees.

slides.headline: "Going on the sunrise tour rocked"
slides.body: Cool air, busy birds, a birthday that started outside.

slides.headline: Book the morning, not the dinner
slides.body: Birthdays, anniversaries, the person who has everything. A sunrise on the bayou beats another candle.

slides.kicker: Send this to whoever has a birthday coming
slides.headline: Start their birthday on the bayou
slides.body: Tours and rentals from Allen's Landing, 1019 Commerce St. Book at buffalobayoukayak.com.
